# wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account (Data Source)

Get information on a local domain account resource linked to a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get information about a specific device local domain account
data "wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account" "admin" {
  device_id    = wallix-bastion_device.server1.id
  domain_id    = wallix-bastion_device_localdomain.local.id
  account_name = "administrator"
}

# Use the account information to look up its credential
data "wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account_credential" "admin_password" {
  device_id  = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account.admin.device_id
  domain_id  = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account.admin.domain_id
  account_id = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account.admin.id
  type       = "password"
}

# Output account configuration
output "admin_account_info" {
  value = {
    id                    = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account.admin.id
    account_login         = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account.admin.account_login
    auto_change_password  = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account.admin.auto_change_password
    services              = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account.admin.services
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `device_id` (String)
- `domain_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `account_login` (String)
- `auto_change_password` (Boolean)
- `auto_change_ssh_key` (Boolean)
- `certificate_validity` (String)
- `checkout_policy` (String)
- `credentials` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `description` (String)
- `domain_password_change` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `services` (Set of String)

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>

### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `public_key` (String)
- `type` (String)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Keys

This data source requires three keys to locate the account:

- **device_id**: The internal ID of the parent device
- **domain_id**: The internal ID of the parent local domain (`wallix-bastion_device_localdomain`)
- **account_name**: The name of the account within that local domain

### Credentials

The `credentials` attribute returns a list of associated credential entries (`id`, `type`, `public_key`), but never returns secret material (passwords or private keys). Use `wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account_credential` with the credential `id`/`account_id` to check credential metadata; the actual `password`/`private_key` values are never exposed by the API, on this data source or on the credential data source.

### Service Configuration

The `services` attribute lists the protocols (e.g. `ssh`, `rdp`, `vnc`, `telnet`, `rlogin`) enabled for this account on the device.

### Prerequisites

The referenced device and local domain must already exist:

1. `wallix-bastion_device`
2. `wallix-bastion_device_localdomain`
